## What changes

Describe the problem and resulting behaviour. Include a safe reproduction example where useful.

## Validation

State the checks actually run and their results. Describe material checks that remain unverified.

## Review checklist

- [ ] This change uses synthetic examples and contains no confidential data or credentials.
- [ ] Behaviour, documentation, and relevant tests agree.
- [ ] Approved exports preserve their exact candidate's stored bytes, where applicable.
- [ ] New dependencies or third-party material have their licences and notices recorded.
- [ ] Every contributed commit contains my own DCO `Signed-off-by` certification.
